# Identity collection segments whose casing never appears in recorded GCP traffic.
#
# The segment an Identity builds goes into a GCP resource name: status.externalRef,
# and the names handed to the API. It has to match the API byte for byte. This is
# not KRM field naming, which is a separate namespace handled by GetJSONForKRM and
# checked by TestCRDsAcronyms.
#
# Each entry below is a resource whose identity builds a name GCP has never seen.
# KCC still reconciles them, because the API calls are built elsewhere and get the
# casing right. What is wrong is the identity string, which is what users are given
# in status.externalRef and what ParseXExternal accepts in spec...Ref.external.
#
# This file is a ratchet, so entries may be removed but never added. Fixing one
# changes a published status.externalRef value, which is why they are recorded here
# rather than fixed in place.
[identity-casing] collection "backupvaults" is never used in recorded traffic (traffic uses backupVaults): netapp/v1alpha1/netappbackupvault_identity.go
[identity-casing] collection "datastores" is never used in recorded traffic (traffic uses dataStores): discoveryengine/v1alpha1/discoveryenginedatastore_identity.go
[identity-casing] collection "managedfolders" is never used in recorded traffic (traffic uses managedFolders): storagecontrol/v1alpha1/storagemanagedfolder_identity.go
[identity-casing] collection "nodegroups" is never used in recorded traffic (traffic uses nodeGroups): dataproc/v1alpha1/dataprocnodegroup_identity.go
